# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in Scient Desktop privately, in either of these ways:

- Email [yaacov@scientfactory.com](mailto:yaacov@scientfactory.com).
- Open a [private security advisory](https://github.com/ScientFactory/scient-desktop/security/advisories/new)
  on this repository.

Do not report a vulnerability in a public issue, pull request or discussion, and do not disclose it
publicly until it has been fixed.

Include what you can:

- the Scient version and operating system;
- steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept;
- what an attacker could do with it.

Reports are handled on a best-effort basis. You can expect an acknowledgement within a few days.
